name: Ashton
startIntroPart1: Paul Ashton, the people of Ashton welcome your leadership. Their civilization is built on inquiry, institutional memory, disciplined preparation, and the conviction that knowledge carries responsibility.
startIntroPart2: Will you seek evidence before confidence, strengthen those who stand with you, protect those placed in your care, and answer aggression with decisive resolve? Will Ashton endure through the ages?
declaringWar: We did not choose this lightly. What follows is deliberate.
attacked: You have mistaken restraint for weakness. That error will be corrected.
defeated: The record remains. Learn from what happened here.
introduction: Ashton greets you in peace. Let us see what we can learn from one another.
tradeRequest: I believe this exchange may benefit us both.
